# IOP_s5l8920x_firmware

L'extension du noyau qui porte le firmware du coprocesseur pour cette puce.

Chaque entrée est une fonction ou une table lue dans le binaire décompilé. Elle consigne ce qui a été lu, avec son statut ; aucun code d'Apple n'est stocké ici. Les notes elles-mêmes sont rédigées en anglais.

## IOP_s5l8920x_firmware class registration (metaclass constructor, allocator, instance constructor head)

Entrée `0x80480328` · Relecture : partial · 2 affirmations · 1 question ouverte

- **IOP-CLASS-001** (device disassembly verified): The metaclass constructor registers the class name "IOP_s5l8920x_firmware" with superclass metaclass object 0x8039aaf8 (IOSlaveFirmware's, per the module init of IOSlaveProcessor.kext) and instance size 0x54 (84 bytes), then stor…
- **IOP-CLASS-002** (device disassembly verified): The allocator (entry of the metaclass table 0x804805c0 at offset +0x44) allocates 0x54 bytes and calls the instance constructor 0x804802b4, which calls the IOSlaveFirmware base constructor 0x803997c5 and stores 0x80480614 as the…

- *Ouverte* **IOP-CLASS-Q1**: Instance constructor 0x804802b4 read only to its first external calls (offset 0x804802cc); the rest, and the value of the object at 0x80480a6c passed to the base constructor, were not read.

[Fiche complète](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/blob/main/tools/iop_analysis/catalog/IOP_s5l8920x_firmware/class_registration.yaml)

## firmware_memory_descriptor_getter (working name, not Apple's)

Entrée `0x80480254` · Relecture : complete · 1 affirmation · 3 questions ouvertes

- **IOP-GETMD-001** (device disassembly verified): A lazy getter: if the field at this+0x50 is zero, it calls the external function 0x801ea699 with (0x80481000, 0x1b000, 3), stores the result at this+0x50, calls the result's vtable slot +0xa0 with (result, 0), and returns this+0x…

- *Ouverte* **IOP-GETMD-Q4**: Whether this getter is the callee of startCPU's +0x34c call depends on the receiver's class: see ARM7M-STARTCPU-Q4.
- *Ouverte* **IOP-GETMD-Q2**: Slot +0xa0 of the returned object, called with (object, 0) right after creation; role unknown (a prepare or wire step is a guess).
- *Ouverte* **IOP-GETMD-Q3**: The third parameter of the resolved function is an IODirection; the meaning of the constant 3 was not decoded.

[Fiche complète](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/blob/main/tools/iop_analysis/catalog/IOP_s5l8920x_firmware/get_memory_descriptor_0x80480254.yaml)
